description:
You are a Database Administrator tasked with optimizing query performance. A development database has been set up at /home/ga/Documents/databases/chinook_perf.db.

Your Goal: Analyze four slow queries, create specific indexes to optimize them, and document your work.

1. Connect to the database in DBeaver:
   - Driver: SQLite
   - Path: /home/ga/Documents/databases/chinook_perf.db
   - Connection Name: 'ChinookPerf' (exact case)

2. Analyze these four queries using 'Explain Execution Plan' (Ctrl+Shift+E) to understand why they are slow (full table scans):

   Query 1 (Monthly Revenue): SELECT BillingCountry, strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS Month, SUM(Total) FROM invoices WHERE InvoiceDate BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2012-12-31' GROUP BY BillingCountry, Month;

   Query 2 (Customer Lookup): SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, COUNT(i.InvoiceId) FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE c.City = 'Berlin' GROUP BY c.CustomerId;

   Query 3 (Composer Search): SELECT t.Name, t.Composer, a.Title FROM tracks t JOIN albums a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId WHERE t.Composer LIKE 'AC/DC%' GROUP BY t.TrackId;

   Query 4 (Long Tracks): SELECT t.Name, t.Milliseconds/1000, g.Name FROM tracks t JOIN genres g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE t.Milliseconds > 400000 ORDER BY t.Milliseconds DESC;

3. Create four indexes to optimize these queries. You must create indexes on these specific columns:
   - invoices table: InvoiceDate
   - customers table: City
   - tracks table: Composer
   - tracks table: Milliseconds

4. Save the SQL for your indexes to: /home/ga/Documents/scripts/create_indexes.sql

5. Create a CSV report at /home/ga/Documents/exports/optimization_report.csv with columns: QueryNumber, QueryDescription, IndexName, TableName, ColumnName, Rationale. Add one row for each of the 4 queries explaining the index you created.
